result.rationale: In the new file packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the schema uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`, both of which evaluate to the string "[object Object]". Zod then builds an object schema with a key literally named "[object Object]", so real token fields like expiry_date are stripped/not validated, and the finding's described mechanism (only access_token effectively enforced, no expiry validated, extra properties dropped) is correct. This newly-added code is real, reachable when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALC
